title: INVENTORY CLERK – FARM BASED
description:
INVENTORY CLERK – FARM BASED
Zenag Chicken is a nationally owned company specialised in the production, distribution, and marketing of the highest quality of farm fresh eggs and poultry products in PNG. We are now seeking to recruit a suitable candidate for the role of Inventory Clerk.
This position reports to the Inventory Manager.
The main responsibility for the role is maintaining accurate and timely records of stock movements and transactions.
Duties:
Ensuring accuracy of inventory records against physical stock.
Ensuring timely manner of updating stock records.
Investigating & resolving of inventory discrepancies.
Providing weekly accurate reports.
Required Skills & Specifications
Must have a Certificate/Diploma in Accounting/Accounting degree or any.
Familiar with Microsoft Office, Excel & Outlook
Have 1 – 2 years’ experience in inventory, warehouse, or stock management systems.
Familiar with any Inventory System.
Must be flexible with working hours.
Ability to work with minimum supervision.
Must have good communication skills.
If you are interested, apply now with your updated CV, latest references and a one-page letter selling yourself to
[email protected]
with the Heading Application for Inventory Clerk. Hand delivered applications can be dropped at our main office at Marsina Street, Towards Lae Main Wharf area.
Please note, ONLY short-listed candidates will be contacted for an interview.
Closing date for submissions is 07/11/2025.
